headline: NQ is +0.5–0.7% pre-open on lower oil and an Anthropic IPO chip bid, but it is still inside Friday's cash range with the Fed, Microsoft and Alphabet all due Wednesday. Wait for a break of the overnight high or a fill of Friday's settle.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window

flip.long: NQ breaks and holds above the overnight high (29,354; ≈ NDX 29,194), which also puts cash NDX above Friday's 29,161 high. Better if chips (NVDA/MU/AVGO) keep their premarket gains and the 10-year stays under ~5.00%.
flip.short: NQ gives back the gap and loses Friday's settle (29,117.75; ≈ NDX 28,958, Friday's close). Stronger below the overnight low (29,024.25; ≈ NDX 28,864) and Friday's 28,826 cash low, especially if oil rebounds or neoclouds keep sliding.

thesis: There's no clear edge at the open, but the tone is better than Friday. The NDX closed Friday flat at 28,957.53 (−1.17 pts) inside a 28,825.72–29,161.03 range, after Thursday's 2.9% AI selloff [1]. Overnight, Nasdaq-100 futures are up ~0.5–0.6% at ~29,262–29,292 (8:36–8:40 AM ET), in a 29,024.25–29,354.00 range, so they are trading near the top of it [2,3]. Two things are helping. Oil is lower, with WTI ~$101 (−2%) as Qatari mediators visit Tehran, and chips are up on reports that Anthropic will file for its IPO today (Nvidia +1.4%, Micron +2.3%, Broadcom +1.5%) [3,4,5]. Against that, neoclouds (CoreWeave, Nebius, IREN) are falling again after Elon Musk warned of 'guppy-level death' for the group, and Brazilian assets are crashing after Lula's surprise win [4,10,11]. The 10-year is flat near ~4.99%, just under 5% [7]. The only data so far was the Chicago Fed index, which came in at 0.07 vs −0.1 expected [6,9]. The bigger issue is the calendar. The Fed decides Wednesday (90% hold, but **December: ~69–75% for a hike**), and Microsoft and Alphabet report that same day, with Amazon also due this week [4,5,6,8]. A futures-implied cash open near ~29,100 sits inside Friday's range, below its 29,161 high [1,2]. Ahead of that much event risk, the call is **stand aside until the overnight high breaks or Friday's settle fails**.
evidence_cutoff: Mon Oct 26, 2026, 8:53 AM ET (9:53 AM Atlantic). Latest futures quotes: 8:36 AM ET (Markets Insider), 8:40 AM ET (Yahoo, may be delayed).

bullets.label: The gap is up, but it's inside Friday's range.
bullets.text: NQ is +0.5–0.6% pre-open and trading near its overnight high [2,3]. On a ~160-pt futures premium, that implies a cash open near ~29,100, which is still below Friday's 29,161 high and well inside last week's selloff [1,2]. That's an estimate, not a quote.

bullets.label: Oil and chips are doing the lifting.
bullets.text: WTI is down ~2% to ~$101 and Brent ~1.4% lower as Qatari mediators travel to Tehran [3,5]. Chips are up on reports Anthropic files for its IPO today: Nvidia +1.4%, Micron +2.3%, Broadcom +1.5%, AMD +1.3% [4].

bullets.label: The AI-financing worry hasn't gone away.
bullets.text: CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN are down ~2–3% premarket after Elon Musk said 200+ neoclouds face 'guppy-level death'; the group is already down over 30% each in October [5,10,11]. Brazil's ETF (EWZ) is down ~26% premarket after Lula's surprise reelection [6].

bullets.label: Big events come later in the week, not this morning.
bullets.text: Only the Chicago Fed index is out (0.07 vs −0.1 expected); Dallas Fed manufacturing comes later this morning [6,9]. The Fed is in its pre-meeting blackout. The FOMC decision, Microsoft and Alphabet earnings are all Wednesday, with PCE and Q3 GDP also this week [4,5,6]. Today's NDX reporter is Cadence Design [6].

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: Oil is coming off a near six-month high, the 10-year is holding just under 5%, and chips have a fresh catalyst in the Anthropic IPO filing [3,4,5,7]. After two straight losing weeks and a flat Friday at Thursday's close, a break above Friday's 29,161 high could squeeze shorts toward 29,188–29,200 ahead of the megacap reports [1,6].

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: Meta disappointed last week by raising AI spending again and selling stock to pay for it, and neocloud credit stress is spreading [5,10]. December hike odds are ~69–75%, and Bank of America expects a hike Wednesday [4,8]. A gap-up into heavy event risk can easily fade back to Friday's settle and below.

bullets.label: Flip to LONG:
bullets.text: NQ breaks and holds above the overnight high (29,354; ≈ NDX 29,194) through the first 30 min, so cash NDX clears Friday's 29,161 high. Ideally with oil staying lower, SMH holding its premarket gain and the 10-year under 5.00%.

bullets.label: Flip to SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ fills the gap and loses Friday's settle (29,117.75; ≈ NDX 28,958). Stronger below the overnight low (29,024.25) and Friday's 28,826 cash low, especially if WTI moves back above ~$103 or the 10-year holds above 5.00%.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: Anthropic IPO filing details, Middle East and Houthi/Saudi headlines, more neocloud or AI-credit news, Brazil contagion, and any Fed leak ahead of Wednesday's decision [3,4,5,6,10].

data_notes: NQ quotes are indicative (Markets Insider is from market makers; Yahoo may be delayed ~10 min). The NQ gain ranges from +0.4% to +0.7% across sources and times (Yahoo blog, CNBC, Markets Insider). The overnight range comes from Yahoo's Oct 26 daily bar as of 8:40 AM ET and may have changed since. The implied NDX open uses Friday's ~160-pt premium (NQ settle 29,117.75 vs NDX close 28,957.53) and is an estimate. Brent differs by source: Markets Insider and CNBC show ~$115 (−1.4%), while Yahoo's blog says 'below $110' and TradingKey shows $109.96, probably a different contract month; WTI is ~$101 everywhere. Fed odds differ by source: FXBus/CME FedWatch shows Dec one-hike 68.9% (~6:00 AM ET), another FedWatch report shows 67.5% + 6.7% for two, and a FedWatch-method mirror shows 75.4% + 8.2% (8:44 AM ET). Investing.com's Fed Rate Monitor timed out and was not used. The 10-year quote is from 8:35 AM ET. The Chicago Fed index is the only data released so far; Dallas Fed manufacturing (prior 9.8) is due later this morning. No Fed speakers ahead of the Oct 27–28 FOMC. Cadence Design (NDX) reports today; Microsoft and Alphabet report Wednesday, and Amazon later this week.
